steps.title: Scale in the SAME actual linear domain
steps.text: Put r_n=epsilon_n*u_n in the genuine domain. The actual self variational test gives energy; scaling and true partial linearity give the residual and gradient energy estimates, also when f=0.

steps.title: Derive actual scaled gradient strongzero
steps.text: Squeeze true squared norms by epsilon_n*normf^2, pass through sqrt and the genuine norm-tendsto criterion. No unscaled gradient or solution limit is assumed.

steps.title: Extract a genuine weak subsequence
steps.text: For each bounded subsequence, map its actual vectors through the Riesz isometry into WeakDual. Explicit separability gives genuine sequential Banach-Alaoglu. Pull the limit back by inverse Riesz and prove every inner evaluation limit.

steps.title: Use the correct Hilbert product graph
steps.text: Ordinary H*K has max norm. Comap the SAME D.graph to WithLp2 through its actual linear equivalence; continuous ofLp gives true closedness. Double orthogonal equals this actual closed submodule.

steps.title: Admit the actual weak-strong graph limit
steps.text: Pair each (r_n,Dr_n) with every vector in G-perp. Weak first component and strongly-zero second component preserve all zero pairings. Double orthogonal and mem_graph_iff produce an actual domain witness equal to v with Dv=0.

steps.title: Force residual normzero along that subsequence
steps.text: The actual forcing/kernel orthogonality gives <f,v>=0. Energy normr^2<=<f,r>, weak evaluation and square-root squeeze therefore give strong residualzero. This uses no Poincare or unscaled uniform bound.

steps.title: Promote to whole-sequence convergence
steps.text: Apply the true subsequence-tendsto criterion to every index sequence tendingatTop. Each has a further actual weak subsequence and the same strongzero limit, yielding the whole residual limit and retaining the scaled-gradient limit.
